gameWatch.title: Jahmyr Gibbs receptions · OVER candidate
gameWatch.quoteNote: BetMGM article dated Sep 16, 11:10 AM; side price unavailable. Not a live sportsbook quote.
gameWatch.why: Week 1 produced 29 carries, 5 catches and 5 targets: 34 touches, matching the shared chart. Receptions are the relevant part of that total for this market. Quick outlets could help with Detroit’s line absences, but routes and pass-protection assignments still need confirmation.
gameWatch.defense: Compare Buffalo pressure with Detroit routes versus pass-blocking assignments. Buffalo lists Cole Bishop and T.J. Sanders questionable; their availability could change coverage and pressure. A favorable reception matchup is not established yet.
gameWatch.lineHealth: Detroit ruled out Christian Mahogany (hip) and Blake Miller (knee) on Sep 16. Juice Scruggs finished full participation without a game designation. Confirm replacements and game-day inactives.
gameWatch.lineSkill: Detroit’s Sep 14 report described Ben Bartch’s first game as uneven, citing one QB hit allowed and a 66.7 PFF run-block grade. One game does not establish unit quality; pass-block and run-block performance must be evaluated separately.
gameWatch.risk: Protection problems could keep Gibbs blocking rather than running routes. A move to 4.5 changes the question materially; no playable cutoff has been established.
gameWatch.needs: Verify current line AND price, last 5/10 exact-market logs, routes and target share, replacement linemen, Buffalo availability and a role-adjusted projection. Do not promote based on injuries alone.
